visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt, speaking directly into the camera in a selfie-style shot. The lighting is bright natural daylight, and he uses hand gestures to point towards the surroundings. (2) The scene transitions to the exterior of a building labeled '露營狼戶外' with a wolf-head logo on a white sign. The camera pans from the sign to the entrance of a large warehouse-style building. (3) The camera moves inside, revealing a high-ceilinged retail space packed with camping equipment. Shelves are stocked with boxes, brown and black folding chairs are displayed in the center, and various camping heaters are lined up on a wooden counter. The lighting is bright and even from overhead studio-style fixtures. (6) A technical section shows Bluetti portable power stations on a shelf next to SOTO brand stoves and gas canisters. Large wooden shelves are filled with camping poles and more equipment boxes. (7) A section dedicated to lanterns features Petromax and Coleman brands, including teal and black metal oil lamps. Another wall displays Morakniv and Opinel folding knives in their packaging. (8) The camera focuses on a large stack of Thor-brand storage bins in olive green, gray, and white, showing various sizes. (9) The tour concludes in a wood-themed area showing low wooden camping tables and a 'fire pit' display with split logs, a large black metal fire pit, and a tall tripod-style lamp stand over a patch of artificial grass.
